prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web interface concept, 1440 × 900 landscape
Primary request: Redesign the ‘Memories’ page for the personal archive ‘nono & txx’. This is an Experience surface where real photographs lead. The concept is ‘Two Photographic Ribbons’: two continuous rails have deliberately different depth, scale, cadence, and speed, like two people’s viewpoints crossing into one shared archive. Hovering or selecting a photo pauses the motion and reveals only its date, viewpoint, and one short memory line.
Real content: ‘nono & txx’, ‘Memories’, ‘since 2025.09.17’, ‘nono 记得’, ‘txx 记得’, ‘管理照片’, ‘暂停’, ‘时间线’, ‘故事从这里开始’, ‘立即备份’.
Reading order: compact archive header; modest title with relationship metadata; one near photographic ribbon with larger mixed-width images; one quieter distant ribbon offset by half a photograph; a selected photo carrying a small caption; below, a calm timeline entrance with three readable event nodes. Management is secondary.
Frame: finished edge-to-edge working website, including navigation, utility controls, first viewport and the start of the timeline. No browser chrome, device, desk, or poster framing.
Reference image contribution: preserve the warm neutral ground, refined serif/sans contrast, thin rules, generous breathing room, and understated controls. Do not copy its equal card widths, oversized title, repeated faces, yellow star placeholder, or exact layout.
Visual law: warm white uncoated photo paper, near-black ink, muted wine accent only for focus and destructive warnings; minimal hairline borders, almost no shadow, no gradients or glassmorphism. The nearer rail is crisp and tactile; the farther rail is lighter and smaller without blur.
Constraints: must read as a real website rather than a poster; visible pause/continue control; legible Chinese; complete images with moderate cropping only in rail thumbnails; no black viewer; no decorative icons; no fake claims; no watermark.
